about.title: About
about.description: About LuckyLab — the tech stack, focus areas and open source contributions of an indie developer.
about.heading: About Me
about.subtitle: Indie developer · Full-stack web apps · Automation tools
about.p1: I'm an indie developer who enjoys using technology to solve practical problems in daily life and work. My stack centers on TypeScript and Python — I build modern web applications with Next.js and am familiar with backend development on serverless platforms like Appwrite and Cloudflare.
about.p2: Besides web development, I'm also passionate about desktop automation tools and data visualization — I once prototyped a no-code desktop automation tool with PySide6 and presented complex business data with visualizations like radar charts. I prefer simple, efficient technical solutions and aim to ship usable products with minimal complexity.
about.p3: In open source, I maintain several public repositories covering practical tools, a link directory and data visualization projects, and I contributed as an Arctic Code Vault Contributor to code permanently archived by GitHub.
about.honor: ★ Honor: GitHub Arctic Code Vault Contributor

holiday.name: Holiday — Holiday Calendar
holiday.description: A clean interactive holiday calendar app built with Next.js. Supports wheel-based month switching, highlights today, and is optimized for both mobile and desktop.

functionstore.name: FunctionStore — Serverless Function Repository
functionstore.description: A self-hosted serverless function management platform built on Appwrite. A collection of cloud functions written in Python that package common backend logic into reusable FaaS workflows.

dateview.name: DateView — Data Visualization Dashboard
dateview.description: A Next.js data display and radar-chart visualization app. Explores combining Edge Functions with the frontend, optimizing data fetching and chart rendering performance.

fnav.name: FNav — Link Directory
fnav.description: A personally curated, minimal link directory collecting common online tools, development resources and community entry points.

autotask.name: AutoTask-UI — No-Code Desktop Automation
autotask.description: A desktop automation prototype built with PySide6 that abstracts repetitive steps into configurable tasks, precisely replayed in the background by PyAutoGUI.

bitresonance.name: BitResonance
bitresonance.description: An experimental exploration of byte-level data processing and signal resonance concepts; documentation to follow.
